scope: External broker PR, checks and reviews read-only follow-up
implemented: Signed grant, Host projection, request and durable ledger bind exact repository, head branch and explicit base branch. PR-related reads require distinct head/base and the requested PR number.
Host routes all six authorized inspection kinds through the external broker. Existing grants without baseBranch preserve their canonical digest and do not gain PR authority.
Broker reuses the existing bounded GitHub GET transport with branch/PR creation disabled, validates strict wire DTOs and retains untrusted/truncated metadata.
Host and broker reserve one GitHub API unit for PR inspection and two for checks or reviews. Durable cumulative budgets and semantic no-replay survive restart.

integrationEvidence.observed: Three authorized reads succeed; over-budget read never dispatches; repeated reviews key after restart returns durable result with transport count unchanged at three.

limitations: No live GitHub request, remote CI/review result or independent-UID deployment is claimed.
External branch/PR creation, compensation, verified delivery and repository-goal readback remain unsupported; this is not the complete repository-maintenance vertical flow.
A successful snapshot is not goal completion or mutation settlement; truncated checks/reviews cannot establish an overall verdict.
